newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta central bank opens new dealing room.
newsitem.headline: Malta central bank opens new dealing room.

text.p: The Central Bank of Malta opened a new dealing room on Wednesday to enable it to undertake international investment operations in real time with correspondent banks.
Bank governor Francis Vassalo said the volume of transactions through the bank had risen to $8 billion this year to September from $3 billion in 1994.

"The new dealing room is equipped with state-of-the-art technology to enable the bank to undertake international investment operations in real time with its correspondent banks," Vassallo added at a short ceremony to inaugurate the new operation.
